text: In an effort to promote international cultural exchanges on campus, a Sino-Western Cultural Festival will be hosted by our university next month. This notice is for the purpose of recruiting 20 enthusiastic student volunteers.

Candidates who wish to apply are expected to satisfy the following requirements. Above all, applicants must possess fluent spoken English and excellent interpersonal skills. Furthermore, prior experience in coordinating volunteer activities will be viewed favorably. Responsibilities mainly entail providing guide services for overseas guests and assisting in venue setup.
Those who are interested should submit an electronic application form to `volunteer@university.edu.cn` before November 15th. We sincerely look forward to your active participation.
